title: lean-ordinal-analysis: Generic verified ordinal notation systems
description: Executable recursive ordinal notation systems in Lean 4. Version 0.3.0 extracts a reusable verified ordinal-notation API from the completed ε₀ development, including exact initial-segment certification, generic zero/successor/limit classifiers, and certified limit sequences with strict monotonicity, boundedness, semantic cofinality, and convergence. The verified ε₀ system is packaged as a reference implementation of the generic interfaces.
